title: Dependency risk forecast and commitment negotiation workflow
creator: Priya Desai
description:
Background: As Redwood scales product and platform work across Hosted, Dedicated and Private, latent cross-team dependencies are the primary source of roadmap slippage. Current dependency tracking is mostly manual (spreadsheets, ad-hoc Slack threads) and doesn't surface week-over-week risk changes tied to telemetry (build failures, infra queue pressure, PR velocity).

Goal: Build a lightweight, repeatable workflow that (1) synthesizes a short-term dependency risk forecast using signals from engineering and infra telemetry, design reviews, and security gating; (2) surfaces a suggested commitment negotiation payload (options for scope reduction, swap-in alternatives, or shifted milestones) for PMs to present in planning cadence; and (3) embeds audit trails and fallbacks so partners can accept, counter, or auto-escalate.

Scope: The deliverable is a productized workflow and a minimal UI and API integration with existing Roadmap tools and Slack for negotiation. It will include: risk scoring heuristics (signal mapping), a negotiation template (automated suggestions ranked by customer impact and implementation effort), a small interactive Slack bot for pro forma negotiations, and a QA runbook for use in cycle planning.

Out of scope: Full automated rescheduling across all roadmaps, deep ML forecasting beyond heuristics, and enterprise billing integration.

Acceptance criteria:
1) Risk forecast can run nightly and surface a ranked list of up to 25 active dependencies with a 3-level risk tag (low/medium/high) plus rationale strings.
2) Negotiation payload generator creates at least two viable alternatives per high-risk dependency: (A) descope plan, (B) alternate owner/implementation, (C) soft delay with rollback plan.
3) Slack negotiation flow allows the owner and dependent PM to accept or counter a proposal and records the decision in Roadmap Resilience project with a link to the negotiation thread.
4) Pilot across three cross-functional initiatives (runtime-1.18 rollout, console-2025.03 UX changes, private-deploy onboarding) completed with retrospective notes and measurable reduction in last-minute scope changes in the pilot cycle.

Deliverables:
- Spec doc (Confluence) describing signals, heuristics, and API contract.
- Minimal frontend in Console to review dependency forecast and proposals.
- Slack bot prototype and templates.
- Runbook for PMs and ENG leads describing how to use outputs in a negotiation.

Success metrics:
- 30% reduction in emergency rework items from dependencies in pilot initiatives.
- >75% of negotiation outcomes recorded in the workflow (no manual emails).
- Positive PM/ENG survey score (>=4/5) on negotiation usefulness in pilot teams.
